responsibility: This header provides the default macro initializers for a generic GCC backend target, supplying standard values for pieces of the target hook table before a specific port overrides them. It defines defaults for assembler directives, constructor/destructor emission policy, related target macros, and then pulls in the generated hook initializers from target-hooks-def.h together with generic hook libraries and instruction-target defaults, making TARGET_INITIALIZER expansion possible in a backend’s definition of targetm.
